why: Ablation for the per-turn protocol injection. At the 2026-07-28 benchmark this was a 785-char reminder injected EVERY turn, accumulating (the results in results/benchmark.json measured THAT surface); on 2026-08-03 it was trimmed to a 230-char nudge, partly on this case's finding. The with arm here runs the full plugin MINUS the per-turn hook; comparing this case's with-rate to shape-header's with-rate isolates the hook's turn-one contribution. (Its post-compaction and long-session role is NOT measurable in a one-turn eval and stays labelled unmeasured.) Since 2026-09-25 the headers and the per-turn hook apply only in a cadence-enabled project, so the setup enables the cadence.
